Definition: to muzzle; by analogy, to stop the nose
BiblicalUsage: Chacam means to muzzle, to stop up. The law says not to muzzle the ox when it treads out the corn, and Ezekiel says the burial valley of Gog will stop the noses of travellers passing by.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God muzzles no worker and stops up no honest mouth — but He will stop the road of the proud dead.
